# awscc_apiportal_discovery_configuration (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::APIPortal::DiscoveryConfiguration



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the discovery configuration.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the discovery configuration was created.
- `discovery_configuration_status` (String) The status of the discovery configuration.
- `discovery_features` (Set of String) Optional discovery capabilities to enable.
- `discovery_sources` (Set of String) The AWS services whose resources are scanned to discover APIs.
- `excluded_resources` (Set of String) ARNs of resources to exclude from discovery.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the discovery configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the discovery configuration was last modified.

### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `value` (String)
